name: 48660-decode-dsv4flash-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, EP on, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine over the eight GPUs of one node, expert-parallel over the in-tree `allgather_reducescatter` all2all backend, so nothing touches the NIC.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM -- a 43-layer sparse-MLA mixture-of-experts decoder with four-bit expert weights; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate 1 req/s, bounded at 128 requests / 1800 s safety, with 24 warmup and 24 cooldown requests by count. Concurrency is EMERGENT, not pinned -- no `max_concurrency` is set, so in-flight count = rate x service time = 1 req/s x (1024 output tokens x per-token time). The source's own box settled at ~8 in flight; ours settles in proportion to whatever our per-token time turns out to be, and a higher figure here is arithmetic rather than a deviation.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt exactly 2 tokens and output exactly 1024 (min = max on both), `request_format: plain` against the raw completions endpoint, temperature 0.0, seed static 48660.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing 1024-token continuations from tiny prompts, one request per second on eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit cc25f028b76844024fddd0b4ca18d4ca169b32be (v0.23.1rc0-1250-gcc25f028b7).
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true
all2all-backend: allgather_reducescatter

# HAZARD, SM90: this is the sparse-MLA backend for this model family that runs on an H100.
# FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4 reports `supports_compute_capability` = `major in [10, 12]` at this
# commit and refuses the card outright.
attention-backend: FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV4

kv-cache-dtype: fp8
tokenizer-mode: deepseek_v4

# The checkpoint declares `max_position_embeddings: 1048576`; no request here exceeds 1026 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096
